name: haushaltsauktion
description: Haushaltsauktion — faire, spielerische Verteilung von Haushaltsaufgaben

scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck:e2e
scripts.seed: npm run build -w packages/shared && npx tsx --env-file=.env apps/api/prisma/seed.ts
scripts.create-admin: npm run build -w packages/shared && npx tsx --env-file=.env apps/api/prisma/create-admin.ts
